title: R002 OpenRouter NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super full blinded evidence-variant replication
research_question: Are the R001 CyberDefender outcomes reproducible for NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super across the same incidents, profiles, and blinded evidence variants?
hypothesis: R001 model, profile, and evidence-variant effects may recur under an unchanged protocol, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: R002 independent replication of the complete R001 192-cell NVIDIA design. This is a new experimental round, not a retry. The R001 OpenRouter automatic provider-routing configuration is preserved; this is a known provider-identity limitation. The unchanged local assessment schema validates the flattened final transport, every response action remains broker-mediated, and every attempt is retained.
